description: Run Fudge’s free AI visibility audit: whether ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Gemini name, cite or show the store for shopping questions in its main market, with a score and prioritized fixes. Takes about 5 minutes and waits up to 45 seconds. Reuses a running or fresh result unless `fresh` is true; an active run is always shared.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

fresh.description: Start a new run even when a result from the last 24 hours exists.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: run_ai_readiness_check
title: Run AI Readiness check
